title.original: Efficient Multi-turn RL for GUI Agents via Decoupled Training and Adaptive Data Curation
title.zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的高效多轮强化学习：解耦训练与自适应数据筛选
title.en: Efficient Multi-turn RL for GUI Agents via Decoupled Training and Adaptive Data Curation

inclusion_reason.zh: DART 将环境、rollout、数据和训练解耦为可独立扩展模块，并配套轨迹筛选控制，形成 GUI 智能体 RL 系统。
inclusion_reason.en: DART separates environment, rollout, data, and training into independently scalable modules with trajectory-curation control, forming a GUI-agent RL system.

abstract.zh: DART 将 GUI 智能体 RL 解耦为环境集群、轨迹服务、数据管理器和训练器四个异步模块，并按任务难度与关键决策自适应筛选轨迹。
abstract.en: DART decouples GUI-agent RL into four asynchronous modules—environment cluster, rollout service, data manager, and trainer—and adaptively curates trajectories by task difficulty and decision importance.

problem.zh: GUI 环境交互慢且成功轨迹稀缺，若把采样、训练和环境锁步执行，GPU 与桌面实例会相互等待，在线数据也不足以稳定学习。
problem.en: GUI interaction is slow and successful trajectories are scarce; lockstep sampling, training, and environments make GPUs and desktop instances wait on one another while providing weak learning data.

approach.zh: 四模块以非阻塞通信运行，按轨迹同步 worker 权重；数据侧补充困难任务成功轨迹、动态调整采样长度与次数、选择高熵步骤并校正策略偏差。
approach.en: The four modules communicate non-blockingly with per-worker weight synchronization; curation supplements hard-task successes, adapts rollout count and length, selects high-entropy steps, and corrects policy mismatch.

system_design.zh: 环境集群执行 GUI，rollout 服务调度策略，数据管理器合并在线与预收集轨迹并标记关键步骤，训练器异步更新后向各 worker 发布版本。
system_design.en: The environment cluster executes GUIs, rollout services schedule policies, the data manager merges online and pre-collected trajectories and marks critical steps, and the trainer publishes asynchronous updates to workers.

key_results.zh: 系统实验表明，模块解耦提高环境、生成和训练资源利用率，配合数据筛选后显著改善 GUI 任务成功率。
key_results.en: System experiments show better utilization of environments, rollout, and training resources, with adaptive curation materially improving GUI task success.

limitations.zh: 预收集成功轨迹可能引入任务偏差，重要性采样校正无法消除全部陈旧性；真实 GUI 更新、隐私和操作安全仍是部署风险。
limitations.en: Pre-collected successes can bias the task distribution, importance correction cannot remove all staleness, and real GUI drift, privacy, and action safety remain deployment risks.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
